thesis: The speaker argues that Charlie Munger's primary lesson is his stoic behavior of not engaging in self-pity and continuing forward regardless of personal hardships. Additionally, the speaker advises college students to open a commission-free brokerage account at a discount broker rather than Robin Hood to avoid treating investing like a video game.
